profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Harris Corporation

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on user interfaces in javascript, rendered in Adobe Air, generated via xml and xsl transforms.  Interesting stuff.  Enjoying working with some great people on great projects.  It does not get much better.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing and building internal web applications to support executive management decisions, streamline processes, and foster closer colaboration among international product divisions.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: HARRIS Corporation, RF Communication Division, Rochester NY
positions.description: Developed a web based application to support resource capacity allocation management for executive management. Cooperative support with Information Services organization to manage existing and future projects.  Provided Web development enhancements to support Manufacturing and Supply Chain work requests.

positions.title: Performance Engineer
positions.description: Create performance tests using Visual Studio to identify performance and scalability issues within the companies application suite.  Create tools to assist other developers and testers.  Support scrum teams in their performance objectives and execute performance tests within a controlled environment.  Also responsible for maintaining hardware which supports performance testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement new features, and improve functionality and performance of existing features for Digital and Computed Radiographic product software.

positions.title: Analyst/Programmer
positions.description: Collect software requirements from end users.  Implement desired features in WinForms or Web  Applications.  Find and resolve defects in applications.  Troubleshoot and resolve end user problems and complaints.  Provide Desktop Support to end users when required.

positions.title: Dragon Anti-Tank Missile Gunner
positions.locationName: 2nd Battalion, 2nd Marines, Weapons Company, Camp Lejeune, NC
